params.label: Rovers
params.help: Fleet size. Changing it restarts the mission with fresh trust.

params.label: Scenario seed
params.help: Fixes spawn points and the hidden reliability field.

params.label: Cruise speed
params.help: Upper bound on forward speed; wheel limits still apply when turning.

params.label: Time scale
params.help: Speeds up driving without changing the planner cadence.

params.label: Radio range
params.help: Rovers further apart than this cannot link.

params.label: Packet loss
params.help: Chance a link goes unobserved in a cycle, which makes its quality stale.

params.label: Links per rover
params.help: Hard degree cap in the QUBO. A spanning tree on 3+ rovers needs at least 2.

params.label: Link budget
params.help: Hard cap on total quantized link cost. Below the cheapest spanning tree the planner relaxes it and says so.

params.label: Annealer restarts
params.help: Warm start plus random spanning-tree starts. Two is the floor: with one, an infeasible warm start leaves no feasible start at all.

params.label: Cooling rate
params.help: Closer to 1 cools slower: better optima, longer solves.

params.label: Tasks per cycle
params.help: Tasks dispatched each planning cycle; capped at the fleet size.

params.label: Exploration
params.help: Chance a task goes to a random eligible rover to keep trust estimates honest.

params.label: Trust memory
params.help: EWMA weight on past trust. Higher reacts slower to new outcomes.

params.label: Reliability drift
params.help: How fast each rover's hidden reliability wanders per cycle.

presets.name: Field survey
presets.description: Eight rovers on a balanced radio budget. The everyday setting.

presets.name: Rapid response
presets.description: Six fast rovers and a one-second planning cycle for the lowest latency.

presets.name: Relay corridor
presets.description: Ten rovers with long radios; the QUBO trims a dense mesh to a lean backbone.

presets.name: Dense swarm
presets.description: Twelve rovers on short radios, with faster cooling to keep cycles under a second.

presets.name: Full fleet
presets.description: Sixteen rovers, the console's maximum. Planning takes about 1.5 s per cycle.

presets.name: Hostile radio
presets.description: Heavy packet loss and drifting reliability. Watch trust track the hidden truth.

presets.name: Tight constraints
presets.description: Two links per rover and a small budget. The planner relaxes constraints and reports each relaxation.

comparisons.label: Bit-flip simulated annealing

reference.source: Battle test H: 25 instances with enumerated ground truth. Random restarts were infeasible in 19 of 25. Our annealer moves only between feasible link sets, a richer move set than single bit flips, so read this as an engineering result rather than a like-for-like sampler benchmark.
